chunks: Al-Sakuni narrated through his chain, saying:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: “Travel and you will gain health; perform jihad and you will attain spoils; and perform hajj and you will become self-sufficient.”

key_terms.تَسْتَغْنُوا: You will become self-sufficient or enriched
key_terms.تَصِحُّوا: You will become healthy; indicating health as a benefit of travel
key_terms.تَغْنَمُوا: You will attain gain or spoils
key_terms.جَاهِدُوا: Perform jihad; strive in the path of Allah

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about the benefits of travel, jihad, and hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages beneficial action by linking travel with health, jihad with gain, and hajj with sufficiency. It presents these acts as carrying worldly and spiritual benefits, while especially highlighting hajj as a means connected to enrichment and independence.
